snippet.title: THRASHER Steam Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
THRASHER is an award-winning arcade odyssey and audiovisual experience coming to Steam on November 7, 2025! Guide a magnificent space eel, elegantly swooping and thrashing it through mesmerizing alien worlds in the ultimate race for survival.  Dive into the circle-based combo system, and play any way you like on PC, VR and Steam Deck. 

Wishlist here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2702300/Thrasher
